lead: A `dossier.py --run hostile` sweep started while `nv verify --start` is still running fails attacks that pass alone, as `still running after Ns -- unbounded`.
body: The build and the test binaries take the cores the attacks' time limits were set against, so heavy attacks (`Core\Html::sanitize`, `Core\Http\Response::jsonAs`, `Core\IO::append`) miss their limits and the report looks like a regression across unrelated members. Run the sweep after `nv verify --wait` returns; only the cases that failed run again, because the green ones are cached.
